description:
Updated to add attachment A00001 - 70ZL1727QCLEV0004 Question and Answer Sheet and to change applicable NAICS from 238340 to 238330. 

 Removal of existing tile flooring and installation of new flooring in the galley at USCG Station Saginaw River. 

 This solicitation is a total small business set-aside. The applicable NAICS is 238330 with a Small Business Size Standard of $19.0M.  

 Provide all necessary labor, materials, and equipment necessary to remove existing tile flooring in galley and install new flooring at USCG Station Saginaw River, 2405 Weadock HWY, Essexville, MI 48732.  Refer to the Statement of Work and Question and Answer Sheet for requirements.  No incumbent exists as this project is a new requirement. US Coast Guard Base Cleveland intends to issue a firm-fixed price contract resulting from this solicitation. 

 Site visits are highly encouraged and recommended for the development of an accurate quote.  Site visits can be scheduled by contacting the Project Point of Contact, MKCS Travis J. VanWinkle, (402)-709-4114, Travis.J.Vanwinkle@uscg.mil. 

 Any and all questions regarding this solicitation shall be submitted via email to the Contract Specialist, Kara Davis at Kara.A.Davis@uscg.mil no later than 5 days prior to the bid deadline on the attached “Request for Information” form. An amendment may be posted to clear up any ambiguities and answer all questions at one time. No oral questions will be accepted. Late questions may not be answered on time. 

 Quote shall be submitted via email to the Contract Specialist, Kara Davis at Kara.A.Davis@uscg.mil no later than 03 December 2026, 4:00 PM Eastern Time.
